import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long mod1 = 998244353L;
    static final long mod2 = 1000000007L;
    static List<Long>[] val = new ArrayList[10];
    static long n, cnt1, cnt2, ans, sum[] = new long[10];
    static long[] Pow = {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000};

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            val[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static boolean check(long x) {
        long now = 1000000L;
        return x * now + 999999L <= n && x * now * 10 > n;
    }

    static void dfs1(int x1, long x2) {
        if (x1 == 7) return;
        val[x1].add((cnt1 - x2 + mod1) % mod1);
        sum[x1] += (cnt1 - x2 + mod1) % mod1;
        cnt1++;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs1(x1 + 1, x2 * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static void dfs2(int x1, long x2) {
        if (x2 > n) return;
        if (check(x2)) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                long now = ((cnt2 + 1 - (x2 * Pow[i])) % mod1 + mod1) % mod1;
                int pos = lowerBound(val[i], (mod1 - now));
                ans = (ans + (sum[i] + now * val[i].size() - mod1 * (val[i].size() - pos))) % mod2;
            }
            cnt2 += cnt1;
        } else {
            cnt2++;
            ans = (ans + ((cnt2 - x2) % mod1 + mod1) % mod1) % mod2;
            for (int i = (!x1) ? 0 : 0; i <= 9; i++) {
                dfs2(x1 + 1, x2 * 10 + i);
            }
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long target) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= target) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        cnt1 = 0;
        dfs1(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(val[i]);
        }
        cnt2 = -1;
        ans = 0;
        dfs2(0, 0);
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
